description:
Connect Power Query to OneDrive and SharePoint files so refresh works for everyone.
👉 Black Friday is coming up. Our best offer of the year goes to newsletter subscribers first. Sign up here so you don’t miss it: https://link.xelplus.com/yt-d-newsletter

🎓 Master Excel Power Query (500,000+ enrolled in our courses): https://www.xelplus.com/course/excel-power-query/?utm_source=yt-video&utm_medium=vid-description&utm_campaign=power-query&utm_content=power-query-onedrive-links

When you connect through File Explorer, Power Query saves the path on your computer. Your colleague's path is different, so their refresh fails. I show you how to connect with the web link instead, for Excel files and text files, and how to switch queries you already built.

✅ Good to know
Use Copy Path, not Copy Local Path. Then delete ?web=1 at the end of the link.
This works for OneDrive for work or school and SharePoint. Personal OneDrive links work differently.
